info.title: ramzes admin API
info.description: Everything the web UI can do. Authenticate with the session cookie or `Authorization: Bearer <API token>`.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password.
End the current session.

get.summary: The signed-in user.
The whole configuration as YAML, for keeping in version control or moving to another instance.

post.summary: Replace the configuration with an exported one. Stored credentials and source keys are kept.

get.summary: Configuration changes, newest first.
The configuration as it was after one change.

post.summary: Make the configuration what it was after a past change. Source keys are not affected.

get.summary: All connections, without credentials.

post.summary: Create a connection. Credentials are encrypted before they are stored.

put.summary: Change a connection. Without `credentials` the stored ones are kept.

delete.summary: Delete a connection. Routes that target it will fail to deliver until they are changed.

post.summary: End a connection's pause now and send what was waiting for it.
Send a test message through a connection and report what the service said.

get.summary: The connector definitions users added.

post.summary: Add a connector described by a YAML definition.

put.summary: Replace a connector definition. Its kind can only change while no connection uses it.

delete.summary: Delete a connector definition that no connection uses.

get.summary: The connectors this binary has, with the fields each needs.

post.summary: Send a delivery again, to the same target.

get.summary: A page of events, newest first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return events older than this id. Use `next_before` from the previous page.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Exact topic, or a pattern where `*` matches any run of characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the title.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Received at or after this time, unix milliseconds.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Received at or before this time, unix milliseconds.

get.summary: Everything that happened to one event: routes matched, deliveries and their attempts.
The message each target of an event receives: its wording and the request that carries it.

post.summary: Run an event through the current routes again.

get.summary: Deliveries that failed for good, newest first.

post.summary: Send several deliveries again.

get.summary: A page of notifications, newest first.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
States to include, separated by commas: `grouping`, `held`, `sent`, `acknowledged`,
`resolved`, `suppressed`. All when absent.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return notifications older than this id. Use `next_before` from the previous page.

get.summary: One notification with its events and deliveries.

post.summary: Acknowledge a notification: reminders stop, and one still waiting is not sent.
Close a notification by hand. Nothing is sent.

get.summary: Volume, delivery results, the noisiest sources and the failing connections of a period.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: How many hours back to look, 1 to 744. Default 24.

get.summary: All routes in evaluation order.

post.summary: Add a route after the existing ones.
Set the evaluation order of all routes.
Evaluate an event against routes and show what each would send. Nothing is stored or sent.

put.summary: Replace a route. Its position is kept.

get.summary: Instance settings.
Whether the instance still needs its first user.

post.summary: Create the first user and sign them in. Works only while no user exists.

get.summary: Silences, the one ending last first. Ended ones are included.

post.summary: Silence matching events for a period: they are recorded but sent nowhere.

delete.summary: Delete a silence from the list.

post.summary: End a silence now.

get.summary: The kinds of source ramzes understands, with how to set each up.
All sources.

post.summary: Create a source. The response is the only time its key is shown.
Try a mapping on a request body without saving anything.

delete.summary: Delete a source. Its events are kept.

put.summary: Replace the mapping of an any-JSON source.

get.summary:
The source's recent requests, newest first: rejected ones for native sources, all of them
for the other kinds.

post.summary: Replace a source's key. The old key stops working immediately.

get.summary: Live changes as server-sent events.
get.description:
`event` carries `{"event_id"}` when an event has been routed. `delivery` carries
`{"event_ids", "delivery_id", "state"}` after each delivery attempt. `notification` carries
`{"notification_id"}` when a notification changes state. `resync` means changes
were missed and the client should reload.

get.summary: All templates.

post.summary: Create a template: the wording of a message, usable by any route target.

Word an event with a template that need not be saved, and optionally show the request a
connection would send for it.

delete.summary: Delete a template that no route uses.

get.summary: All admin API tokens, without their values.

post.summary: Create an admin API token. The response is the only time its value is shown.

get.summary: All users.

post.summary: Add a user. Every user is an administrator.

delete.summary: Remove a user and end their sessions. The last user cannot be removed.

ApiToken.description: An admin API token. The token itself is never stored, only its hash and a display prefix.

status.description: HTTP status, when the service answered.

start.description: Start of the bucket, unix milliseconds.

ConnectionHealth.description: How a connection's deliveries went over a period.

last_error.description: The most recent failure in the period.

credentials.description: Leave out to keep the stored credentials.

ConnectionView.description: A connection as the API shows it: without its credentials.

failure_streak.description: Attempts that failed in a row.

has_credentials.description: Whether secret fields have been stored. Their values are never returned.

oneOf.description: How its deliveries of the last 24 hours went. Absent when there were none.

paused_until.description: Set while the connection is paused after failing repeatedly; deliveries wait until then.

ConnectorDescriptor.description: What a connector is and which settings it needs. Drives the setup form in the UI.

custom.description: Added by a user as a definition, rather than shipped with ramzes.

destination_label.description: What a route's destination means for this connector, when it uses one.

Dedup.description: Events with the same key as an open notification are counted, not sent again.

key.description:
An expression giving the key. Without it the event's own `dedup_key` is used, and
failing that its topic and labels.

window_s.description: Seconds after a notification is created during which duplicates are absorbed.

DefinitionRow.description: A connector definition added by a user. `definition` is the YAML text.

Delivery.description: One send of a notification to one target.

external_ref.description: The service's id for the delivered message, when it gives one.

warning.description: Something went wrong that did not stop the send, for example a template that failed.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

deliveries.description: Deliveries queued by the current routes.

targets.description: Names of the connections the event was sent to, in order of first use.

EventRow.description: An event with a summary of what happened to it, for lists.

yaml.description: The configuration as YAML, without credentials or source keys.

name.description: Absent when the connection was deleted.

connection_name.description: `None` when the connection has been deleted.

FailureRow.description: A failed or dead delivery with enough context to show in a list.

secret.description: Secret fields are stored encrypted and never returned by the API.

Group.description: Events are collected and sent as one message.

by.description: Labels whose values define a group. Empty means one group per target.

repeat_s.description: Seconds after which a sent notification that is still open is sent again.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait after the first event before sending.

Journey.description: Everything that happened to one event.

held_until.description: When a held notification is released.

role.description: How this event relates to the notification: `first`, `duplicate`, `grouped` or `resolved`.

oneOf.description: `pattern` is a regular expression searched for in the label value; anchor it to match the whole value.

error.description: Why the mapping or the body could not be used.

events.description: The events the request would produce.

body.description: A request body to try it on.

id.description: Absent when the request used an API token.

MessagePreview.description: The message one target of an event received, as it would be worded and sent now.

connection_name.description: Absent when the connection was deleted.

oneOf.description: The request the connector makes, with secrets masked.

request_error.description: Why the request cannot be shown.

warning.description: For example: the route's template failed and the default wording was used.

credentials.description: Values for the connector's secret fields.

settings.description: Values for the connector's non-secret fields.

NewEvent.description: An event as a sender submits it.

ts.description: RFC 3339 time the event occurred. Defaults to the time of receipt.

duration_s.description: How long it lasts from its start, in seconds.

ends_at.description: When it ends, unix milliseconds. Give this or `duration_s`.

match.description: Which events to silence. At least one condition is required.

starts_at.description: When it starts, unix milliseconds. Defaults to now.

key.description: Use this secret instead of a generated key, for senders that generate their own.

mapping.description: The mapping of an any-JSON source, as YAML. A starter mapping is used when absent.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

connection_name.description: Absent when the connection was deleted.

next_timer_at.description: When it is next due to be sent, released or repeated.

sent_count.description: Messages sent for it so far.

severity.description: The highest severity among its events.

title.description: The title of the event that opened it.

buckets.description: Events per bucket, for buckets that have any, oldest first.

failing.description: Connections with failed deliveries in the period or paused now, worst first.

since.description: Start of the period, unix milliseconds.

unacknowledged.description: Notifications sent and neither acknowledged nor resolved.

waiting.description: Notifications collecting or held right now.

Preview.description: The request a connector would send for a message, with secrets masked.

connection_id.description: Also show the request this connection would send.

event_id.description: The event to word. Without it the newest event is used, or a sample when there is none.

QuietHours.description: A daily period in which notifications are held and sent as one digest when it ends.

oneOf.description: Events at or above this severity are sent anyway.

days.description: Days on which a quiet period starts: `mon` … `sun`. Empty means every day.

end.description: When it ends, `HH:MM`. Earlier than `start` means the next morning.

RateLimit.description: At most `max` notifications per window; the rest are held and sent as one summary.

ids.description: Every route id exactly once, in the new evaluation order.

summary.description: What changed, for example "changed route billing".

config.description: The configuration after this change as YAML, without credentials.

key.description: Use this secret instead of generating a key.
The new ingest key. Shown only in this response.

shaping.description: What the route does besides sending: dedup, grouping, quiet hours, rate limit.

stop.description: When this route matches, routes after it are not evaluated.

shaping.description: Dedup, grouping, quiet hours and rate limit. Empty sends every matching event at once.

stop.description: When this route matches, routes after it are not evaluated.

RouteMatch.description: The conditions of a route. Every condition that is set must hold.

expr.description: An expression over the event (`payload`, `labels`, `topic`, …) that must be true.

topic.description: Glob over the whole topic: `*` matches any run of characters.

route_id.description: Absent for a route that is not saved.

targets.description: What each target would receive, when the route matched.

results.description: One entry per route, in evaluation order.

last_error.description: Why the route's expression last failed. Cleared when the route is saved.

RouteView.description: A route with the last failure of its expression, if any.

public_url.description: Address of this ramzes instance, used for links in messages.

retention_days.description: Days events are kept. Zero keeps them forever.

retention_overrides.description: Days per topic, overriding `retention_days`. Zero keeps that topic forever.

needs_setup.description: True until the first user has been created.

Shaping.description: A route's shaping policy. Empty means every matching event is sent at once.

notify_resolved.description: Tell a target when something it was notified about is resolved.

Silence.description: A period during which matching events are not sent anywhere.

SilenceRow.description: A silence with who created it.

Source.description: A producer of events. The ingest key itself is never stored, only its hash and a display prefix.

mapping.description: The mapping of an any-JSON source, as YAML. Bundled kinds carry their own.

key.description: The ingest key. Shown only in this response.

SourceKind.description: A kind of source, for the UI to offer.

own_secret.description: The sender generates the secret, so the user has to give it to ramzes.

setup.description: How to configure the sender. `{url}` and `{key}` stand for the source's address and key.

oneOf.description: How requests prove where they come from. `None` for kinds whose mapping decides.

SourceRequest.description: A request a source sent that ramzes rejected, kept for debugging.

headers.description: The request's headers as a JSON object, without credentials. Kept for adapter sources.

path.description: `/v1/events` for native sources, `/v1/in/{id}` for the others.

SourceView.description: A source with the path its sender posts to.

Step.description: One shaping step and what it concluded, for the journey and the route tester.

Target.description: Where a route sends: a connection and an optional destination within it (for example a channel).

template_id.description: The template that words the message for this target. Without one the event's own text is used.

connection_name.description: Absent when the connection does not exist.

outcome.description:
What shaping would do right now: `sent`, `not sent`, `joins an open notification`,
`opens a group`, `held` or `resolves an open notification`.

steps.description: The shaping steps that led there.

warning.description: For example: the template failed and the default wording would be sent.

Template.description: User-written wording for a message. An empty part keeps the default.

body.description: Template for the body. Empty keeps the event's body.

title.description: Template for the title. Empty keeps the event's title.

error.description: Why the template could not be used; the default wording is shown in that case.

event_id.description: The event the preview was made from.

oneOf.description: The request the chosen connection would send.
Or an event written for the test.

event_id.description: A stored event to test with.

routes.description: The routes to test, in order, saved or not. Without them the stored routes are used.

status.description: HTTP status the service answered with, if it answered.

value.description: The token. Shown only in this response.

oneOf.description: The named header carries the source key.
The named header carries the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body, keyed with the source key.

prefix.description: Text before the hex digest, for example `sha256=`.

oneOf.description: The source key is a query parameter of the URL.

Verify.description: How a request to a source's URL proves it comes from the sender.
